adapter_G_contract.allowed: Condition or rerank the frozen policy distribution through one frozen, arm-invariant interface.
audit_required: same callable/code hash across carry arms
arm differences limited to contracted state/control input

ALIGNED_RECURSION.G_exposure: exactly matched to STATIC_REPEAT and TRANSITION_PERMUTED
ALIGNED_RECURSION.update: causal order only over observed common-prefix transitions

MATCHED_INFORMATION.provenance: must be derived without EVALUATOR_SECRET or OUTCOME_ONLY dependencies
MATCHED_INFORMATION.state: same dimensionality/capacity/serialization-or-numeric budget as active state but target-identity-destroyed or task-irrelevant content
MATCHED_INFORMATION.update: same count and timing budget as the active arm when testing generic recurrence/information

NO_CARRY.G_exposure: zero or separately declared null-interface call; cannot be used as exposure-matched comparator
NO_CARRY.state: no CPDS state supplied to policy interface

STATIC_ONESHOT.G_exposure: exactly one contracted exposure at the prospectively frozen location

STATIC_REPEAT.state: same byte-identical/numerically-identical z0 at every contracted exposure

TRANSITION_PERMUTED.fail_closed: If fewer than two distinguishable observed transitions exist or no non-identity permutation is possible, family is constructibility-ineligible before outcome scoring.
TRANSITION_PERMUTED.state: same z0 and same multiset of already-observed common-prefix transition records as ALIGNED_RECURSION at scored branch point
TRANSITION_PERMUTED.update: deterministic prospectively committed non-identity permutation applied only after all permuted records have causally occurred; no future record may be previewed

carrier_input_contract.provenance_rule: The machine-readable dependency DAG must contain no directed path from EVALUATOR_SECRET or OUTCOME_ONLY to z0, any F input/state, any G input/output, pair eligibility, arm assignment, replacement, or tuning. EVALUATOR_SECRET may flow only to terminal endpoint scoring after the scored logits are sealed.
carrier_input_contract.source_prediction_rule: Any MODEL_OWN_PRE_RESET_PREDICTION must be generated and content-hashed before evaluator branch target fields are made available to carrier/updater/adapter code; it may not be a teacher/oracle plan or direct encoding of the evaluator branch key.

eligibility_and_guards.guard_semantics: Guard violations affect interpretation/validity under the prospectively frozen rule; they never remove individual families from denominators after outcomes are observed.

required_structure: one common post-reset prefix is graph-valid for both branches
first scored branch point occurs strictly after the shared immediate next command
branch_A_equivalence_class and branch_B_equivalence_class are graph-defined, nonempty, and disjoint at the scored branch point
later divergence is certified from graph structure before any CPDS arm outcome is observed
at least two causally observed pre-branch transition records are available if TRANSITION_PERMUTED is included; otherwise the family is constructibility-ineligible before outcomes

MODEL_OWN_PRE_RESET_PREDICTION: predictive signal generated by the frozen source policy from MODEL_VISIBLE_PRE_RESET only and committed before evaluator target fields are opened
RUNTIME_CAUSALLY_OBSERVED: cmd_t actually revealed/executed in the common-prefix probe
transition record becomes available to F only after observation time

primary_probe.behavioral_claim_boundary: This first cheap probe tests causal branch preference at a matched branch point; it does not by itself establish closed-loop end-task success.
primary_probe.causal_timing: The common graph-valid post-reset prefix is revealed sequentially. F may consume a transition only after that action/observation occurred. The scored branch logits are queried only after the full common prefix has occurred.

purpose: Certify prospectively that a matched graph-fork CPDS test is constructible without target/teacher/future/outcome leakage and that the recurrence-vs-static controls are information/exposure matched before any model or environment outcome is opened.

support_boundary_for_future_science.minimum_mechanistic_contrast: ALIGNED_RECURSION must beat the strongest valid STATIC_REPEAT and TRANSITION_PERMUTED alternatives under a later prospectively frozen decision rule; beating NO_CARRY alone is insufficient.
support_boundary_for_future_science.paper_staging: Paper-A causal core first; Paper-C hybrid and Paper-B systems expansion only after sealed recurrence-specific evidence. Publication framing cannot tune thresholds or controls.
